The '''main base''' of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orion IV]] after the Rebels were forced to [[Battle of Brigia (Galactic Civil War)|evacuate]] their [[Brigia Rebel base|base]] on [[Brigia/Legends|Brigia]] when it was targeted by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as part of [[Operation Strike Fear]].<ref name="CSWE-Brigia">{{CSWECite|I|93|Briggia}}</ref> However, the Orion IV base became the next target of Operation Strike Fear. The Empire launched a [[Battle of Orion IV|assault]] on the base, leading to its destruction and the capture of many Rebel personnel.<ref name="XW">[[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]</ref>
